title: Capcom Is Delisting Exoprimal In A Few Months, Then Killing It In 2027
summary:
Can't believe the dinosaurs are going extinct, again!

Capcom has today announced that its dinosaur PvPvE shooter Exoprimal will end service on September 29, 2027, meaning it will no longer be playable after that date. The game is also set to be delisted from digital storefronts, including the Xbox Store, on March 30, 2027.

"We regret to announce that service for Exoprimal will be discontinued as of 8:00 PM (PDT) on Wednesday, September 29, 2027."

title: GTA 6 Comparison Reveals Two Advantages Of Xbox Series X Over PS5
summary:
But obviously not the PS5 Pro.

The good folks over at Digital Foundry are still busy analysing all things to do with GTA 6's launch last week, and their latest comparison takes a look at all four console versions alongside each other - Series X, S, PS5 and PS5 Pro.

They also go on to rank the versions in order, and perhaps surprisingly, Xbox Series X comes out on top versus the standard PS5. Two reasons are given for this, which are that the Xbox version supports 120Hz VRR to smooth out the dips in frame rate, and that the PS5 sometimes "suffers substantially more frequent frame-rate drops than Series X".

title: Digital Foundry Analyses Whether GTA 6 Could Benefit From 40FPS On Xbox Series X
summary:
"A 40fps mode with VRR could still make sense".

Over the weekend, there was a whole lot of buzz amongst the GTA 6 community about a Quick Resume glitch that unlocks the game's frame rate on Xbox Series X and S, potentially allowing it to reach 60FPS and higher.

Follow-up tests showed that the results were averaging more around the 30-35FPS range consistently, and some of the game's animations appeared to be running at double speed. The experts at Digital Foundry have now weighed in on this, and they've come to pretty much the same conclusion - that it's not really a viable way to play.
